---
# ==============================================================================
# APA 7 manuscript assembly (draft phase only)
# ==============================================================================
# Build:   Rscript paper/build_manuscript.R            -> paper/drafts/manuscript_draft.docx
# Handoff: Rscript paper/build_manuscript.R --handoff  -> paper/manuscript.docx (MASTER)
# After handoff, edit paper/manuscript.docx in Word. This file and
# paper/sections/*.md are no longer the source of truth.
# Standard: .claude/rules/working-paper-format.md
# ==============================================================================
output:
  word_document:
    reference_docx: word/apa7-reference.docx
bibliography: ../Bibliography_base.bib   # exported from Zotero (Better BibTeX: keep updated)
csl: word/apa.csl
link-citations: false
params:
  title: "[Paper Title in Title Case, About 12 Words or Fewer]"
  shorttitle: "[RUNNING HEAD, 50 CHARACTERS OR FEWER]"
  masked: false            # true for masked review: drops authors and author note
  authors: "[Author One]^1^ and [Author Two]^2^"
  affiliations:
    - "^1^[Department of Psychology, University One]"
    - "^2^[School of Education, University Two]"
  author_note:
    - "[Author One] https://orcid.org/0000-0000-0000-0000"
    - "[Disclosures: preregistration link and deviations; data, materials, and code availability; conflicts of interest; funding.]"
    - "Correspondence concerning this article should be addressed to [Author One], [address]. Email: [email]"
  abstract: "[One paragraph, 250 words or fewer (or the journal limit): problem; participants and key characteristics; design and method; main findings with effect sizes and 95% confidence intervals; conclusions and implications.]"
  keywords: "[keyword one], [keyword two], [keyword three]"
  sections: ["introduction", "method", "results", "discussion"]
  appendices: !r character(0)   # e.g., !r c("appendix_a")
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source(file.path("word", "apa_helpers.R"))
```

::: {custom-style="Title"}
\
:::

::: {custom-style="Title"}
\
:::

::: {custom-style="Title"}
`r params$title`
:::

::: {custom-style="Author"}
\
:::

```{r title-page, results = "asis"}
if (!isTRUE(params$masked)) {
  .apa_div("Author", params$authors)
  for (a in params$affiliations) .apa_div("Author", a)
  .apa_div("Author", "\\ ")
  .apa_div("Author", "\\ ")
  .apa_div("Title Page Label", "Author Note")
  for (n in params$author_note) .apa_div("Body Text", n)
}
apa_page_break()
```

::: {custom-style="Abstract Title"}
Abstract
:::

::: {custom-style="Abstract"}
`r params$abstract`
:::

::: {custom-style="Keywords"}
*Keywords:* `r params$keywords`
:::

```{r page-break-1, results = "asis"}
apa_page_break()
```

::: {custom-style="Title"}
`r params$title`
:::

```{r body, results = "asis"}
for (s in params$sections) apa_section(s)
apa_page_break()
```

# References

::: {#refs}
:::

```{r displays, results = "asis"}
apa_displays("displays.csv")
```

```{r appendices, results = "asis"}
for (s in params$appendices) {
  apa_page_break()
  apa_section(s)
}
```
